system_identity.system_type: Verification-first quantitative research platform with CME governance layer and MFN dependency-light gateway.
system_identity.core_transformation: research intent and data/config inputs -> schema-bound artifacts, claim tiers, falsifiers, validation reports, and release evidence.
system_identity.input_state: raw research line, repository context, candidate agent plan, data/config paths, and claim text.
system_identity.output_state: validated or rejected artifact/report with explicit status tier, replay path, and handoff.
system_identity.validation_boundary: README, CLAIMS, FORBIDDEN_CLAIMS, AGENTS, schemas, tests, CLI gates, and release evidence harness.

state_variables.name: intent_state
state_variables.definition: Compressed goal for one iteration or research line.

state_variables.name: context_state
state_variables.definition: Repository files and canonical surfaces used as the boundary for the operation.

state_variables.name: candidate_state
state_variables.definition: Agent-generated plan, patch, or hypothesis before verifier approval.

state_variables.name: claim_state
state_variables.definition: Claim text plus status tier, evidence pointer, and falsifier boundary.

state_variables.name: evidence_state
state_variables.definition: Artifact, raw logs, exit codes, schema result, hashes, replay command, and manifest.

state_variables.name: gate_state
state_variables.definition: Verifier decision surface: pass, fail, reroute, or block promotion.

state_variables.name: artifact_state
state_variables.definition: Committed or generated JSON/markdown output with schema and replay contract.

state_variables.name: verification_state
state_variables.definition: Observed command result and gate evidence. Present as intended command surface; not observed for this Role 1 patch inside this connector session.

state_variables.name: release_state
state_variables.definition: Release verdict plus evidence bundle; documented but not complete for CME boundary audit.

boundary_conditions: No claim without tier, evidence pointer, falsifier, and replay path.
Synthetic or placeholder artifacts cannot promote research status.
Schema validity proves shape only, not empirical truth.
CME agent output remains residual until a deterministic verifier accepts it.
Release status requires persisted evidence, not terminal success text.
forbidden_claims: Any product claim that rewrites GeoSync into a live trading, advice, or alpha product.
Any CME claim that describes autonomous intelligence, consciousness, brain measurement, diagnosis, or therapy.
Any prestige-quality claim not translated into explicit gates and evidence.
non_scope: No brain or cognitive measurement claim.
No replacement of human responsibility with LLM judgement.
No release promotion without executed commands and artifact bundle.

invariants.name: intent coherence
invariants.must_conserve: Each iteration must preserve one primary goal and one first missing condition.
invariants.how_verified: docs/CME_ITERATION_0001.json plus validator checks non-empty singular first_missing_condition.
invariants.failure_if_broken: Agent loop splits into parallel priorities and loses measurable progress.

invariants.name: claim status traceability
invariants.must_conserve: Every claim must keep its tier and evidence boundary.
invariants.how_verified: CLAIMS.md, FORBIDDEN_CLAIMS.md, and claim boundary scripts.

invariants.name: source traceability
invariants.must_conserve: Evidence-bearing outputs must point to source files, artifacts, schemas, and commands.
invariants.how_verified: AGENTS.md evidence-bearing artifact minimum and release rule.
invariants.failure_if_broken: A result cannot be replayed or independently audited.

invariants.name: artifact reproducibility
invariants.must_conserve: Artifacts must include deterministic hashes, seed, timestamp, schema, and replay command where evidence-bearing.
invariants.how_verified: research_inference_artifact schema and geosync-research verify path.
invariants.failure_if_broken: Output becomes a screenshot-grade claim rather than a reproducible artifact.

invariants.name: human responsibility
invariants.must_conserve: LLM and agents propose candidates; humans remain accountable for high-stakes interpretation and release.
invariants.how_verified: AGENTS.md root contract and claim boundary language.
invariants.failure_if_broken: LLM judgement is incorrectly treated as final truth.

invariants.name: proxy honesty
invariants.must_conserve: Proxy metrics and synthetic plumbing must be labeled as proxy/instrumented, not measured truth.
invariants.how_verified: README synthetic-data promotion rule and FORBIDDEN_CLAIMS promotion invariants.
invariants.failure_if_broken: Operational heuristics are misreported as physical measurement.

invariants.name: validation evidence
invariants.must_conserve: PASS requires commands, raw logs, exit codes, schema validation, and evidence bundle when release status is claimed.
invariants.how_verified: README release evidence harness and AGENTS.md release rule.
invariants.failure_if_broken: Green console output masquerades as release proof.
